# Phone Number React (@erag/phone-number-react)

> Headless React hook (`usePhoneNumber`) for country-aware phone inputs. Handles country selection, digit normalization, calling codes, mask patterns, and validation with zero dependencies.

## Core Information
- **Package**: `@erag/phone-number-react`
- **Documentation**: https://erag.in/phone-number-react/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/phone-number-react
- **Author**: Er Amit Gupta (https://erag.in/)
- **License**: MIT
- **Peer Dependencies**: `react` (^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0)
- **Keywords**: react, react-hook, phone-input, phone-number, international-phone, headless, country-code, validation

## Quick Installation
```bash
npm install @erag/phone-number-react
# or
pnpm add @erag/phone-number-react
# or
yarn add @erag/phone-number-react
```

## Quick Start (usePhoneNumber Hook)
```tsx
import React from 'react'
import { usePhoneNumber } from '@erag/phone-number-react'

export function PhoneNumberField() {
  const {
    countries,
    selectedCountry,
    setSelectedCountry,
    callingCode,
    phone,
    handleInput,
    isValid,
    maskPattern,
    formatExample
  } = usePhoneNumber({ initialCountry: 'IN' })

  return (
    <div className="phone-input-group">
      <select
        value={selectedCountry.code}
        onChange={(e) => setSelectedCountry(e.target.value)}
      >
        {countries.map((c) => (
          <option key={c.code} value={c.code}>
            {c.name} ({c.dial_code})
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>

      <span className="calling-code">{callingCode}</span>

      <input
        type="tel"
        value={phone}
        onChange={handleInput}
        placeholder={maskPattern || formatExample}
      />

      {phone && !isValid && (
        <span className="error">Please enter a valid phone number</span>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```
